safety_correction.required_pattern_to_close_current_period: All four remaining dates after confirmed day shifts on 2026-08-09, 2026-08-10 and 2026-08-11.

achievement_days.definition: Days until verified trailing-30-day gross income or a binding next-30-day gross run rate is at least JPY 200,000.

rationale.p20: Optimistic safe case: 18 distributed day shifts are accepted and completed by 2026-09-15, creating a 201,600-yen contractual wage claim without forcing the current-period seven-day run.
rationale.p50: Central case: the qualifying 2026-08-16 through 2026-09-15 period is verified by the scheduled 2026-09-25 payslip/payment read-back.
rationale.p80: Allows one additional pay-period cycle, verified around 2026-10-25, if the first target period does not receive enough accepted shifts.

maintenance_confirmation_days.definition: Two measurements at least 30 days apart are each at least JPY 200,000, with evidence that the following 30 days continue.
maintenance_confirmation_days.rationale: The central case is two consecutive qualifying pay periods with verification around 2026-09-25 and 2026-10-25.

priority_paths.action: Rescan for smartphone-compatible work only when it passes client verification, privacy, platform-risk and effective-pay gates. Do not apply to the screened no-go leads.
